rationale: A wins because it respects the facts and knows when to kill its own darlings. Its line, "Without a bank willing to be identified, this becomes a claim the reporter cannot check," is the kind of restraint that keeps a founder out of trouble. B has useful material, especially "Who holds the keys," but it keeps decorating the update with invented scaffolding like "Notion against Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace" and "spent a decade dismissing" offline. Clever is not a substitute for sourced.
gaps_in_A: "Notion's 100 million users could not get it past bank and hospital compliance" overstates the healthcare side. The update says healthcare was previously blocked; it does not give hospitals, HIPAA, a BAA, or a healthcare customer.
"the features that the company says unblocked these pilots shipped today" leans on causation the facts do not prove. The pilots may depend on the new controls, but that needs confirmation.
"exec-spotlight" is the wrong label for the offline angle. No executive fact is supplied; this is an engineering-source story until Notion produces the engineer.
A misses a strong standalone security-architecture angle around what AWS KMS customer-managed keys actually protect against; it buries that in proof questions instead of making it a beat-ready story.
gaps_in_B: "Notion against Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace" is invented competition. No competitor or suite fight appears in the update.

"A cloud-native workspace is rebuilding for the offline case it spent a decade dismissing" is unsupported theater. The facts say offline-first shipped; they do not say Notion dismissed offline for a decade.

"without raising Enterprise prices" overreads the pricing fact. The update says no pricing change for existing Enterprise plans, not that all new controls are included for all buyers or that new buyers avoid add-ons.

"The bank that wouldn't let its staff use Notion is now piloting it" turns an unnamed pilot claim into a dramatic buyer story the facts do not support. No bank is named, no ban is stated, and pilot scope is unknown.
